confidence: moderate — mechanism-level identification, not a literal re-run of the scenario tuple (see evidence_limits)

evidence_limits.scenario_tuple_absent: The golden scenario definition for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' (participants, levels, ranks, items, fight window) lives outside the permitted evidence tree — grep for 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' across all of data/ returns nothing, and data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no Bloodsong / Black Cleaver / roster scenario. The champion binaries that would pin form stats (data/bin/characters/*.bin.json) are gitignored; only aatrox.bin.json.sample is tracked.
evidence_limits.consequence: The literal inputs cannot be re-simulated from data/ + docs/math-foundations.md. What CAN be decided from the sources is which of the two numbers is reachable by the sourced mechanics of the two items the scenario is named for, and by the mitigation identity the engine claims to instantiate EXACTLY. That is the basis of the verdict below.
evidence_limits.index_alignment_caveat: events[] is compared positionally. If the change altered the event list length upstream of index 35, old-events[35] and new-events[35] may not be the same event. This does not change the verdict (the new value is a legitimate post-mitigation damage number), but it means 'old 90.1 was the wrong value for this event' is the weaker of the two claims.

sources_quoted.text: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

sources_quoted.text: Iceborn: 'slowed by {{rd|25%|{{ap|25*0.5}}%}}' (the known melee-25% / ranged-12.5% split) and Divine Sunderer '{{rd|6%|4%}} of target's maximum health' — establishing {{rd|A|B}} = A melee / B ranged, so Expose Weakness is at most 8% (melee holder).

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md §2.1 + §5 audit table (Resistance mitigation, verdict EXACT)
sources_quoted.text: m(R) = 100 / (100 + R)   (apply_resistance, resistance.py); post = raw · m(R)  ⟺  raw = post · (1 + R/100)
R_final = max(0, (R − r_flat)·(1 − r_pct/100)·(1 − p) − f)   — penetration floors at 0, so m(R) ∈ [1/(1+R/100), 1].
the established model uses a fixed 0.8·max_stacks constant (with a hits/2 short-fight branch) … the exact Cesàro mean of the capped ramp min(k, C) over h hits is C − C(C−1)/(2h).

sources_quoted.source: data/champions.json (stat growth applied per CLAUDE.md / math-foundations §5)

step_1_bound_the_named_item_layer.black_cleaver_ceiling: Carve is 30% armor reduction at 5 stacks (sourced above). Turning the full Carve on/off scales a mitigated hit by (100 + A) / (100 + 0.7·A), which is increasing in A and sup = 1/0.7 = 1.4286 as A → ∞. Under the engine's own 0.8·max_stacks model (24%) the ceiling is 1/0.76 = 1.3158.
step_1_bound_the_named_item_layer.expose_weakness_ceiling: 8% increased damage from all sources (melee holder) = 1.08×; ranged = 1.05×.
step_1_bound_the_named_item_layer.conclusion: 1.5429 < 1.687266. No re-tune of Carve stacking, of the Carve percentage, or of the Expose Weakness amp — separately or together — can move a single damage event by the observed factor. The change therefore lives in whether a mitigation step was applied at all (or in the attacker's damage basis), not in the two items' own knobs.

step_2_identify_the_factor.claim: 0.592675 = 100 / (100 + 68.727) exactly, i.e. the new value is the old value put through ONE application of the EXACT mitigation identity m(R) = 100/(100+R) against a target sitting at R = 68.73 post-penetration armor.
why_that_armor_is_the_scenario's_own_num: Black Cleaver at 5 stacks (sourced 30%): a pre-Carve armor of 98.18 gives 98.18 × 0.70 = 68.73.
Black Cleaver under the engine's documented 0.8·max_stacks model (24%): a pre-Carve armor of 90.43 gives 90.43 × 0.76 = 68.73.

Both pre-Carve values sit squarely in the level-16..19 champion armor band of data/champions.json under the growth formula — e.g. Nilah L18 armor 98.40 → Carve 68.88 → 90.1 × 100/168.88 = 53.35; MasterYi L16 armor 98.14 → 68.70 → 53.41; Rell/Shaco/Sivir/Tristana L18 armor 98.00 → 68.60 → 53.44. Every one of these rounds to 53.4 ± 0.05.

step_3_the_competing_arithmetic_story_an.story: A newly-introduced DOUBLE mitigation also reproduces 0.592675: m² = 0.5927 ⇒ m = 0.7699 ⇒ R = 29.9. Under that story the old 90.1 was already correctly mitigated once and the new 53.4 is a regression.
step_3_the_competing_arithmetic_story_an.rejection: It requires the defender to sit at ~29.9 armor. Sweeping data/champions.json with the growth formula, essentially no champion is near 30 armor at the levels a golden roster fight uses (the level-18 band is ~90–110; the sole outlier is Thresh at 33.0, who has 0 armor growth by design). Worse, it is self-defeating for this scenario: a 30-armor target is exactly the case where Black Cleaver's Carve is worth almost nothing (1.08× at most), so a scenario built and named around Black Cleaver would not be pinned against one. The ~68.7 post-Carve armor of a ~98-armor champion is both the ordinary case and the case the scenario exists to exercise.

step_4_amp_cross_check.note: Neither value is a clean Expose Weakness sibling of the other: 53.4 × 1.08 = 57.67 and 53.4 × 1.05 = 56.07, neither ≈ 90.1. This independently rules out 'the amp was added/removed' as the explanation and is consistent with step 2.
step_4_amp_cross_check.spellblade_basis_cross_check: Bloodsong's Spellblade is 100% BASE AD (not total AD). A base-vs-total AD basis error would need bonus AD = 0.687 × base AD on the holder; with the scenario's own Black Cleaver (+40 AD, data/items.json id 3071 stats.attackDamage.flat = 40.0) that implies base AD ≈ 58, which no Bloodsong-carrying champion has at a level where the support quest is complete. So the basis-swap explanation does not fit either.

independent_computation.conclusion: The only reconstruction that is consistent with (a) the sourced text of both named items, (b) the EXACT mitigation identity docs/math-foundations.md §2.1 says the engine instantiates, and (c) ordinary champion armor from data/champions.json under the growth formula, is: 53.4 is the post-mitigation damage of that pair event against a Black-Cleaver-shredded target at ~68.7 armor, and 90.1 is the same packet one mitigation step short (raw / un-mitigated). A 'pair_damage' leaf in a combat ledger is damage dealt, which by §2.1 must carry m(R); 90.1 is not a legal damage-dealt number against a positive-armor target here.

computed_value_tolerance: ±0.1 (the pre-Carve armor is determined only to ~98.0–98.4, which spans 53.35–53.44)
residual_risk: The scenario tuple is not in the permitted tree, so this identifies the mechanism (a missing mitigation step now applied) rather than re-deriving 53.4 from the literal inputs.

If the change instead re-formed a participant (e.g. a form toggle) and re-indexed the event list, events[35] may be a different event in the two runs; the new value is still a legal post-mitigation number, but the old one would then not be 'wrong' so much as 'a different event'.

Checked and excluded as explanations for a 1.687× swing: Carve stack count/percentage, Expose Weakness 8%/5%, Spellblade base-vs-total AD basis, and (for a Gnar-style Mini/Mega form swap) every Mini/Mega ability-row pair in data/champions.json — Q 125%AD+[5..165] vs 140%AD+[45..225] tops out near 1.23×, and E Hop vs Crunch near 1.07×, both well under 1.687×.
